The podium of the most commented videos in Africa this week.

escenas.texto: Which was the most commented video in Africa this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, جربت أسرع طرق التنقل في ماين كرافت, by Ury 2, with over 3 thousand comments.
In second place, My daily duty as a mom of 5, by Sophie cindy, with over 6 thousand comments.
And number one: اختبر قوة رئتك 🫁🫨, by Mahmoud Zayed - محمود زايد, with over 11 thousand comments.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
